# Wilderness Films India

> Wilderness Films India Ltd. (brand: WildFilmsIndia) is South Asia's largest factual visual archive and independent production house. Founded in 1987 by filmmaker and naturalist Rupin Dang, it holds 150,000+ hours of footage spanning wildlife, culture, landscapes and expeditions across India, the Himalayas and neighbouring countries. Based in New Delhi, India.

## Key facts

- Founded: 1987, by Rupin Dang (Managing Director & Founder; listed in the Limca Book of Records as the youngest filmmaker in India).
- Location: 1 Factory Road, Ring Road South, New Delhi 110029, India.
- Archive: 150,000+ hours of factual/wildlife footage — one of the largest independent collections in South Asia.
- Audience: 5M+ subscribers on YouTube (@WildFilmsIndia).
- Areas of expertise: wildlife cinematography, documentary filmmaking, stock footage licensing, production & location services, nature photography, Himalayan expeditions.
- Clients have included BBC, National Geographic, NHK, Discovery Channel and other international broadcasters.

## Services (Offerings)

- Stock footage licensing — factual, wildlife and cultural footage from a 150,000+ hour archive, SD to 4K, historic formats included.
- Production & location services across India — fixing, crewing, permits, access to remote and sensitive locations.
- Equipment hire and used equipment sales — cine and broadcast cameras, lenses, and accessories (ARRI, Sony, Canon, Fujinon, Zeiss and more).
- Wildlife and documentary cinematography.
